data.gender_notes: Mustafiz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mustafa means chosen one and Z is a suffix that means my or my Lord, so Mustafiz means My Chosen One or Favorite. This name is a derivative of Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) name, Mustafa. The name Mustafiz carries the meaning “Chosen One, Favorite” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Mustafiz usually hope their child will grow to embody chosen one, favorite and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Signifies being chosen by Allah for a special purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mustafiz total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
